svg.title: Where the data goes
svg.desc: Everything stays in the browser on this computer. The popup and the switcher ask the service worker, which keeps a token per account, a password only when one is remembered, the settings of the button and the order of the tiles, when each account last played, the last 50 events of the extension without a name or a secret, the time of the last renewal, whether Autodarts turned every account away in it, and until when a new account is being added, and the ids of the boards each account sees and of the accounts they are shared with, never their names, in chrome.storage.local. It moves a session into the Autodarts page and reads the outgoing one out of it only through content.js, the one script that reads or writes the session in the page's localStorage. To renew a token, sign in with a password, end a session, read the boards that an account sees or seat a saved player in the lobby on the display, with a fresh token, the username and the account id of that player, it talks to api.autodarts.com over HTTPS, the same service the Autodarts page itself uses. The popup and the switcher show each player's picture from the address Autodarts gives for it. Nothing else goes anywhere: no server of the developer, no analytics; Help and Report a problem only open a page in a new tab.
